newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen stocks close lower on holiday mood.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen stocks close lower on holiday mood.

text.p: Shenzhen's A and B share indices dipped to lower closes on Wednesday on consolidation, with investors packing up for the two-week Chinese lunar new year holiday, brokers said.
The B share index shed 0.47 points or 0.3 percent to close at 152.7 points on turnover of HK$113.98 million compared with Tuesday's HK$152.41 million.
The A share index slipped 0.15 points or 0.04 percent to finish at 370.00 points as turnover fell to 5.2 billion yuan from 6.2 billion in the previous session.

"Investors are taking a wait-and-see attitude towards trading before the lunar new year holiday," said a broker with China Guotai Securities. "Market performance after the break will depend on 1996 corporate results."
"The indices will continue to consolidate this week," another broker said.
On the B share market, Lionda, a conglomerate with brewery interests, was the sharpest loser and dipped HK$0.10 or 2.41 percent to HK$4.05 on trade of 269,920 shares.
